Se nel gruppo qualcuno viene preso di mi: If someone is targeted in the group I don’t laugh and I don’t forward, I message the person privately and I tell an adult. In Italy every school has a contact person, and the law protects whoever is targeted.

Dai le regole: si parla dei personaggi e: Set the rules: we talk about the characters and never about classmates; nobody has to share anything personal; anyone can pass. Then a provocative question with no right answer.
<strong>Puoi dire:</strong> «Quante risa: You can say: “How many laughs does it take for a joke to stop being a joke?”
Proietta la tappa 8: scena, storia e vot: Project stage 8: scene, story and vote. Then open the three answers and pause on the one about leaving the group: it protects you, but leaves Tommaso alone.
<strong>Puoi dire:</strong> «Chi attacca: You can say: “Attackers want an audience: every laugh makes them feel stronger. The people watching count too.”
Gruppi da 3–4: dividono le carte nelle d: Groups of 3–4 sort the cards into the two columns using the four criteria on the board. Then each group explains the card they argued about most. When a card splits the group, ask: “And for the person on the receiving end, what is it like?”
Scrivi alla lavagna le tre mosse e falle: Write the three moves on the board and let them practise: each student writes on the ticket the private message they would send the person targeted. Then briefly present the law and the school’s contact person.
<strong>Puoi dire:</strong> «Uno: non ri: You can say: “One: I don’t laugh and I don’t forward. Two: I message privately ‘I saw it. I’m sorry. I’m here.’ Three: I tell an adult, even together with a friend. You don’t have to be a hero: just don’t leave anyone alone.”
Usa le domande qui sotto. Se qualcuno in: Use the questions below. If someone starts describing a real case in the class, thank them and suggest talking afterwards, in private.
Ogni studente completa il biglietto. Ind: Each student completes the ticket. Say who the school’s contact person is and where to find the Get help now page.
<strong>Una battuta tra amici sul tuo go: Friends joke about the goal you missed, and you laugh along A joke. Everyone laughs, including the person it’s about, and it ends there.
<strong>Un meme con la faccia di un comp: A meme with a classmate’s face going round two groups for days Cyberbullying. It repeats, there’s an audience and it uses their face without permission.
<strong>Un gruppo nuovo creato apposta s: A new group created on purpose without one person, to talk about them behind their back Cyberbullying. Excluding and isolating someone is cyberbullying.
<strong>Un profilo falso con il nome di: A fake profile in a classmate’s name posting embarrassing things Cyberbullying. Identity theft is part of the definition in Italian Law 71/2017.
<strong>Uno sticker buffo mandato a un a: A funny sticker sent to a friend, who replies with another sticker A joke. A game between equals that both enjoy.
<strong>Lo screenshot di una chat privat: A screenshot of a private chat sent to the whole class to make fun of someone Cyberbullying. It makes something private public in order to mock: it hurts and it stays.
<strong>Commenti cattivi sotto ogni vide: Nasty comments under every video a classmate posts Cyberbullying. Repeated insults hurt even if they’re “just words”.
<strong>Un soprannome che piace anche a: A nickname the person likes too A joke. If they stop liking it, it stops being a joke.
Perché è difficile intervenire quando ve: Why is it hard to step in when you see something in the group?
<strong>Dove portare la classe:</strong>: Where to take the class: Out of fear of becoming the next target or of being left alone. That’s why small, private moves are enough: a message to the person targeted, an adult told together with a friend.
Where to take the class: No: snitching is getting someone into trouble for your own benefit; asking for help is protecting someone who is suffering.

Where to take the class: In Italy every school has a bullying and cyberbullying contact person. From 14, or through a parent, you can ask the site or social network to remove content; if it doesn’t reply within 24 hours or act within 48, you turn to the Data Protection Authority. For 14 to 18-year-olds there is a formal police warning, and the 114 line offers first psychological and legal support.
Se uno studente racconta qualcosa: If a student tells you something
Ascolta con calma e ringrazia per la fid: Listen calmly and thank them for trusting you. Don’t press with questions and don’t promise to keep it secret: explain that you’ll talk to someone who can help. Follow your school’s procedure and tell the bullying and cyberbullying contact person.
In prima usa sei carte e lascia alla lav: With younger students use six cards and keep the three moves on the board for the whole lesson.
In terza leggete insieme il codice inter: With older students read the school’s internal anti-bullying code together, which every Italian school must adopt by law.
Il messaggio di sostegno si può scrivere: The support message can be written, said aloud or chosen from three suggestions on the board.
A casa, con un genitore, la tappa 8 di P: At home, do stage 8 of First steps with a parent; together write the message you’d send a friend who is targeted and bookmark the Get help now page.
